full_judgment: 18. The provisions are of an enabling character and entitle an assignee to do so, if so desired. It does not make incumbent upon an assignee to make the application if he thinks that his interests are being well looked after by his assignor. It is merely an alternative procedure which guards against the danger that the original defendants are no longer interested in the suit may not prosecute it or may even side with the adversary. Furthermore, under the said provision of the Code the right to apply is a continuing right accruing from day to day and is not subject to the law of limitation.
